$comment: The note fields K2 Horizon may propose from one dictated transcript (FR-11), sent to llama-server as the response format, so the model can't answer in any other shape (the sidecar's prompt.py strips $schema and $comment first). Subjective, Objective, Assessment and Plan only (the expansion plan's step 14): there is no field for orders or allergies (FR-14). Each field is a value and the passages of the transcript it came from, copied word for word; an empty value with no sources means the transcript said nothing for that field. Each field's description is the one statement of what it holds: the prompt repeats it word for word (a test checks), and the note editor (UC 13, UC 14) shows the same definitions under each section's heading (NoteSections in Ehr.Domain; a test checks). The descriptions go to llama-server with the rest of the schema, which turns it into a grammar and ignores them; the model reads them in the prompt. Changing this file needs line-by-line human review (AGENTS.md) and a new eval run (eval/README.md).

subjective.description: What the patient reports: the reason for the visit, the symptoms and their timing, the relevant past and family history, medications and allergies, and readings they took at home.

objective.description: What the clinician found: today's vital signs and examination findings, and the results the clinician has already reviewed (labs, ECG, imaging).

assessment.description: The clinician's impression: diagnoses, differential diagnoses, and how each problem is doing.

plan.description: What the clinician says happens next: treatment, medication changes, tests, referrals, follow-up and advice.
